abstract: Self-contained authoring guide for hoardodile content plugins: the manifest contract, the definePlugin hook contract (detect/sourceMeta/searchMeta/coverLocal/listFiles/imageHashes), the ResourceAPI, the sandboxed iframe client on @hoardodile/sdk-react and @hoardodile/sdk-web, the tarball bootstrap and plugin CLI/workbench toolchain, testing with createResourceAPIFixture, and reference implementations to study.
